newsitem.title: USA: XLConnect sees Q4 EPS of $0.02 to $0.04.
newsitem.headline: XLConnect sees Q4 EPS of $0.02 to $0.04.

text.p: XLConnect Solutions Inc said Friday it anticipates that fourth quarter earnings will be approximately $.02 to $.04 per share, based on preliminary financial results.

It said it expects fourth quarter revenues to increase approximately 40 precent, to between $30 and $32 million, compared with revenues for the similar quarter in 1995. Total revenues are expected to be substantially the same as third quarter 1996, it said.
The information technology company reported a net income per share of $0.05 for the third quarter ended September 30.

The company said the results are due primarily to temporary delays in the commencement of several large projects, unexpected plant shutdowns by several major outsourced desktop clients over the holidays, and fewer working days during the period.
It said it anticipates growth to accelerate during the first half of 1997 as it continues to develop its internal sales force.
The company also said that Richard Ellenberger, chief executive officer, has requested to negotiate his current departure from the company.
